articles.title: SEC Commissioner Peirce counters views that crypto rule will foster synthetic tokens
articles.snippet: Hester Peirce, the commissioner behind the SEC's Crypto Task Force, made statements on the now-delayed proposal, perhaps tamping down mistaken beliefs.

articles.title: Tom Lee says trillions in tech IPO supply won't crash the S&P 500
articles.snippet: Fundstrat’s Tom Lee argues that trillions in new IPO supply from SpaceX, Anthropic, and OpenAI could ultimately be absorbed by underallocated investors.

articles.title: OKX and ICE are bringing 'never-expiring' oil futures to 120 million crypto users
articles.snippet: The new partnership comes as Hyperliquid’s oli futures contracts that never expire have been a huge success with over $1.6 billion in 24-hour trading volume.

articles.title: Crypto majors stuck in tight range as altcoin rotation picks up steam
articles.snippet: Bitcoin holds between $76,000 and $78,000 while AI tokens and HYPE surge; derivatives signal calm conditions with volatility selling dominating options markets.

articles.title: Polymarket aims for prediction market approval in Japan by 2030
articles.snippet: Mike Eidlin, head of Japan at cryptocurrency exchange Jupiter, is leading Polymarket's efforts, according to reports.
